paths.master: caller authority; does not require season master pointer or is_master
paths.eligibility: current active brackets; no submitted check in helper; same-ID pair skipped
paths.writes: one independent bracket_scores upsert per competitor

paths.input: master ID in admin route URL
paths.master: caller ID; checks current/active, not canonical master identity
paths.authorization: JWT admin plus runtime job guard; no explicit users.is_admin recheck here

paths.input: bracket/match IDs and winner or undo

paths.master: frequency of master IDs among eligible stored score rows
paths.eligibility: existing saved/current/active filter and private-league membership
paths.ordering: points descending, full_hits descending, saved_at ascending; missing saved_at last
frontend sorts points/full_hits/saved_at then username/bracket ID

paths.snapshot_gate: existing snapshot call and semantics; deferred unchanged to D2

paths.input: explicit master create/replace intent; generated empty graph
paths.master: B3 trusted atomic season master pointer creation/replacement
paths.authorization: DB admin and existing B3 replacement confirmation
paths.transaction: bracket/graph/pointer in existing B3 transaction; no score recompute before D1
paths.required_D1_integration: After successful canonical master establishment, recompute synchronously against new empty/result truth; leave B3 transaction and policy unchanged

existing_formula.play_in: winner and both participants correct -> 1/full hit; otherwise 0/miss
existing_formula.best_of_seven: winner + exact games + both participants correct -> 3/full hit; correct winner otherwise -> 1/partial; wrong winner -> 0
existing_formula.unresolved_master: missing winner or missing games -> pending
existing_formula.full_hits: play-in full result or winner/games/participants full series outcome; bonuses never counted

schema: bracket_scores stores separate bonus fields, round/match points and total; saved_at is timestamptz on brackets; no base_points column
canonical_fixture: foundation has empty brackets/matches/bracket_scores; scenario score rows are temporary, so formula changes need not alter nc-fixtures-v1 or canonical checksum
independent_design: Canonical master resolver; complete eligible source snapshot; transactional trusted-only score publication with source fencing and unchanged-state no-op; server competition ranks; frontend consumes ranks. No code or migrations written yet.
approved_clarification: Correct winner/different opponent earns 1 point. Three points requires both teams, winner and game count correct. Full-hit participant condition retained; play-in winner hit still worth 1, full hit requires participants.
